subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata result field and server_error-before-failover retry ordering be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877 after proof and conflict refresh?
rationale: The code shape appears correct, but the PR changes a harness result contract and provider retry ordering in a session/message-delivery-sensitive path, which automation cannot accept as product and compatibility intent without maintainer sign-off.

options.title: Refresh and prove this PR, then use it as canonical
options.body: Require a conflict-free branch plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or message side effects, then continue review on this PR.

options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97890 as the canonical landing path if maintainers prefer that implementation shape.
